info.title: Restaurant Operations Platform: Vendor Control Plane API
info.description: Generated from @rp/contracts/control-plane by `pnpm contracts:docs`; do not edit by hand. Restaurant PCs call it: `x-capability` is `INSTALLATION` for requests signed with the installation's Ed25519 key (headers x-rp-installation, x-rp-timestamp, x-rp-nonce and x-rp-signature over `signedRequestMessage`, ADR-0012) or `PUBLIC`. `x-requirements` lists the BRD requirement IDs.

post.summary: Register a restaurant PC with a one-time enrolment code
post.description: Public because the installation has no credential yet: the one-time code and the proof that it holds the private key are its credential. Codes are used once and expire; attempts are rate-limited per client address.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Unknown, used or expired code, or a bad proof.

429.description: Too many attempts from this address.

get.description: Public because the load balancer and uptime monitoring call it; it reveals nothing but whether the service and its database answer.

post.summary: Report that an installation is alive, with its versions and health
post.description: Every 5 minutes by default; the answer sets the next interval, gives the server time and offers the release to update to. Sending the same heartbeat again is harmless.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing or invalid signature, unknown installation, reused nonce, or a clock outside the window (`CLOCK_SKEW`, with `details.serverTime`).

post.summary: Read a printed menu from photos or a PDF (AI-assisted import)
post.description: ONB-006, VCP-008: the files are read by the AI provider, whose key only the Control Plane holds (SEC-002). The answer comes at once with the job; ask for it until it is DONE or FAILED (a menu takes about a minute). The files are deleted once read. What comes back is a draft that a person must check before anything is imported.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing or invalid signature, unknown installation, reused nonce, or a clock outside the window (`CLOCK_SKEW`, with `details.serverTime`).

429.description: The daily number of menus is used up.

503.description: AI import is not set up.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

401.description: Missing or invalid signature, unknown installation, reused nonce, or a clock outside the window (`CLOCK_SKEW`, with `details.serverTime`).

404.description: No such job for this restaurant.

400.description: The request does not match the contract.

post.summary: Vendor staff sign in: email, password and the authenticator’s code together
post.description: Public because it is how a session starts. MFA is mandatory (VCP-001); five failures lock the account for 15 minutes and every attempt is audited (SEC-018).
